Join Diatec A/S

At Diatec, we work with the sales, service, and support of advanced audiological and diagnostic solutions for hospitals, clinics, and hearing care centers across Denmark.

We are part of Interacoustics' global network and are based at our headquarters in Middelfart.

We are looking for a Student Assistant who would like to join a dedicated team and gain hands-on experience in customer service, administrative tasks, and marketing.

Your Responsibilities

As a Student Assistant, you will have a varied role with responsibilities including:

• Coordinating and handling repairs in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

• Preparing and shipping equipmentPlanning and following up on service tasks

• Creating and closing service orders in our systems

• Providing customer support via phone and email

• Handling administrative tasks and ad hoc assignments across the organization

• Contributing to marketing activities, including LinkedIn posts and newsletters

• Assisting with internal activities and events

We Imagine That You

• Are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree and have at least 1-2 years remaining in your studies

• Are service-minded and enjoy working with customers

• Work in a structured manner and have strong attention to detail

• Are curious and eager to learn new systems and processes

• Can work both independently and as part of a team

• Have strong communication skills in both Danish and English, written and spoken

• Have an interest in administration, communication, and marketing

• Can work approximately 10-15 hours per week, with flexibility around exam periods

We offer

• A flexible student job where working hours can be adapted to your studies

• A diverse role with administrative, service-related, and marketing tasks

• An informal and supportive work environment

• The opportunity to build valuable professional experience alongside your studies

• Professional and personal development in an international organization

• Great colleagues and a workplace focused on collaboration and well-being

About Diatec A/S

Diatec A/S is a Danish sales and service company specializing in advanced audiology and balance products.

We are part of Demant's global network and are based at our headquarters in Middelfart.Driven by innovation, quality, and a strong focus on customer service, we work every day to help our customers with solutions that make a difference.

Location: Middelfart

Working hours: 10-15 hours per week

Employment type: Student Assistant Position

Interested?

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. The application deadline is 13 November.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire when we find the right candidate.If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Mads Hansen at +45 63 71 36 66.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

Digital Transformation Lead

Workplace technology shapes the daily experience of everyone who works at Danske Bank. As Digital Transformation Lead, you will connect business needs, technology decisions, and operational realities to help build a workplace that works well for all employees and teams. This is a role where strategic thinking and practical detail go hand in hand.

What you will be doing

You will join a diverse team of seven people within the Center of Excellence in Group Workplace Management, collectively responsible for workplace management strategy, the digital roadmap, workplace insights, and performance management. The team works across a broad stakeholder landscape that includes employees across Danske Bank, external technology suppliers, facility management vendors, application owners, and operational teams. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a practical approach to improvement are central to how the team operates. More specifically, you will:

• Develop and maintain the workplace technology landscape and digital implementation roadmap

• Act as business-side owner for solutions covering meeting management, visitor management, smart storage, and hospitality

• Prepare recommendations to invest in, retain, standardise, consolidate, replace, or decommission technologies

• Identify technology-related compliance gaps and coordinate the necessary business input to address them

• Provide business-side input to technology budgets, licensing requirements, hardware needs, and supplier discussions

• Develop user guides, administrator guides, intranet content, and operational handover material

• Facilitate workshops, define business processes and user journeys, and support testing and implementation

About you

• Experience translating business and operational needs into clear requirements

• Ability to combine strategic thinking with structured coordination and follow-up

• Experience working with technology portfolios, digital solutions, or implementation roadmaps

• Comfortable facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders with varying priorities

• Strong analytical and organisational skills with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics

• Builds trusted relationships and works effectively across teams, functions, and countries

A background in business analysis, technology portfolio management, product ownership, or digital workplace solutions would be advantageous. We value varied experience and welcome candidates who bring a different perspective to this work.

What we offer you

This role gives you direct involvement in shaping the workplace experience for employees, visitors, and operational teams across Danske Bank. You will work in a hybrid setup, typically spending three to four days per week in the office, enabling close collaboration and knowledge sharing with your team. There is genuine scope for learning across both strategic and operational dimensions of workplace technology.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you would like to learn more about this position, please reach out to Andrea Toft, Head of Center of Excellence, Group Workplace Management, at andto@danskebank.dk. Please submit your application by 6 November 2026.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Senior Consultant, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

We are looking for highly motivated and ambitious Senior Consultant who can contribute across a broad spectrum of projects — including implementation, optimization, and ongoing consulting for the commercial area (SFE,CRM). The role is open to candidates with either a technical background or a business consulting mindset, as long as you bring curiosity, structure, and a collaborative spirit.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, helping clients translate business goals into scalable, system-supported solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

• Lead workstreams or small teams on client projects, ensuring high-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment.

• Conduct process assessments and define future-state operating models across commercial functions.

• Translate business needs into system requirements and support end-to-end implementation of platforms.

• Facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and manage documentation (e.g., project plans, RAID logs).

• Support IT and commercial strategy definition, including CRM optimization and system integration.

• Drive change management activities, including training design, stakeholder engagement, and adoption planning.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, bringing structure, insight, and industry best practices.

• Engage in Sales processes by taking part in RfP responses and delivering presentations.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience ideally in project-based roles within consulting or the life sciences sector implementing solutions for the commercial area.

• Required consulting and hands-on experience in Salesforce, Veeva, and other CRM systems (certifications in Salesforce and Veeva will be a plus). Technical understanding is a plus, especially for projects involving IT collaboration.

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written in English.

• Ability to create compelling presentations and confidently present to diverse audiences.

• Proactive mindset with a “can-do” attitude and eagerness to learn.

• Comfortable working in agile teams and remote environments.

• Project Management and Agile methodologies experience (certifications on Agile, PMP... will be a plus).

• Experience facilitating workshops and driving client expectations into sustainable solutions.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage change at scale.

• It will be a plus if you have these additional capabilities:

• Experience working in global or regulated industries (e.g., pharma, finance).

• Prior consulting experience — especially in top-tier consulting firms — is valued but not required.

• Exposure to enterprise platform rollouts or system integration projects.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.

• Experience contributing to Salesforce Effectiveness initiatives, including CRM usage optimization, sales process alignment, and support for user adoption strategies.

• Interest in emerging technologies and AI.

This position is offered in Denmark.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

Senior Manager, Group Development & Strategy

Help shape Coloplast’s growth agenda by sourcing, evaluating and executing strategic transactions across our global business.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager to join Group Development & Strategy at our headquarters in Humlebæk. The role will have a primary focus on M&A while also contributing to selected enterprise strategy projects. You will help develop Coloplast’s M&A agenda, build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities across our business segments, support the M&A Director on key priorities and independently lead selected projects.

The transaction scope spans acquisitions, divestments, minority equity investments and strategic partnerships, as well as integration planning. This is a hands-on role with significant exposure to senior leaders, business segments, global functions and external advisers.

Welcome to Group Development & Strategy

You will join a team of five high-performing specialists across strategy, business development and M&A. Together, we work across group strategy, strategic projects, transactions and post-merger integration, collaborating closely with Executive Leadership and teams across the organisation. You will become part of a distinctive performance culture focused on working together to achieve the best results.

Your key responsibilities includes

•    Support the development of the enterprise M&A strategy and strategic priorities across our business units

•    Source opportunities and maintain the pipeline across acquisitions, divestments, equity investments and partnerships

•    Assess potential targets, including strategic fit, value and key risks, in collaboration with internal stakeholders

•    Support the M&A Director on key transactions and independently lead selected processes

•    Prepare financial models, valuations and business cases

•    Coordinate due diligence across relevant functions

•    Manage relationships with targets, owners and external advisers

•    Support integration planning and the handover to the business

•    Prepare proposals and recommendations for senior management and other internal stakeholders

•    Monitor market, competitor and transaction trends relevant to Coloplast

•    Support on selected enterprise strategy and integration projects

What we expect from you:

•    A relevant commercial master’s degree or MBA

•    5–6 years of experience within M&A and ideally with strategic projects

•    Experience from top-tier consulting, investment banking and/or private equity

•    Strong financial and business modelling skills and hands-on M&A execution capabilities

•    Experience across all phases of a transaction

•    Experience managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously

•    Fluent written and spoken English

•    Experience working in an international environment

•    Experience from healthcare or medical devices industry is an advantage, but not a requirement

How you work

You are intellectually curious and comfortable moving between the big picture and detailed analysis. You create momentum in ambiguous situations, challenge constructively and know when to involve others. You build trust across functions and geographies, remain composed under pressure and balance analytical thoroughness with the pace required in live transactions.

Role details

Location: Humlebæk, Denmark

Team: Group Development & Strategy

Reports to: Group Development & Strategy Director

Travel: Some international travel should be expected, particularly during active transactions.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com..

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Imagine a future where you are a key part of our Asset Integrity Team operating some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets both onshore and offshore

Application deadline

15 Novemberr 2026 , 23:59 CET

Country Denmark

Location Gentofte, Skærbæk

Working hours Full-time

Employment type Permanent

Legal entity Infrastructure Assets

Some of our benefits include:

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for onshore and offshore pipeline operation, inspection, engineering and integrity tasks as well as asset management of the Danish onshore and offshore pipelines and terminals bringing most of the Danish oil and gas into Denmark.

**Welcome to Asset Integrity

**You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the  offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and  offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and  trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Be a part of the data revolution in sports!

This is a great opportunity to join our growing Data Science and BI developer team. Our team is responsible for the development and operations of both our internal and customer-facing reporting and dashboard solutions, as well as our data science and machine learning products. We are focused on making our rich tracking data more actionable to customers as well as supporting our internal product development and operations with useful insights. We also use our data to develop data science and machine learning solutions that enhance our product experiences. In collaboration with our cutting-edge radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by the best athletes in the world.

Example projects we are working on:

• Reporting for environmental variations between stadium tracking locations based on athlete performance models and statistical analysis

• Dashboards for trends and detecting outliers in radar tracking and computer vision diagnostics across thousands of remote devices

• Translating ball tracking metrics into coaching-orientated measures to help amateur athletes improve their performance

• Supervised learning models to suggest both practice and gameplay recommendations to make our sophisticated products easier to use

• Vision-based person detection combined with predicting the position they play on the field for game strategy

Your Profile

You have hands-on experience working with data day to day in SQL and python, from the fundamentals of loading, ETL, and pipeline automation to answering ad-hoc questions from the business and operations teams. You have experience developing reports and dashboards to address the questions that are reoccurring. You are familiar with using a developer tool stack and operating in a scrum team. You also have experience using data science modelling techniques to derive next-level insight from data, as well as an appreciation for running machine learning in production. Your focus is on the practical outcome and value to the business of using data to inform everything we do. You like working in an international team across many cultures. You like sports.

Responsibilities

• Develop internal and customer-facing BI reports and dashboards

• Use dimensional modelling to develop database schemas and semantic layers

• Manage data warehouse data pipeline automation rules, ensure smooth operations

• Work with our Data Engineers to acquire and prepare working data, initial data cleaning, statistical analysis, and mining

• Interface with product owners, operations, and developers to refine requirements

• Identify and perform data science model selection, feature engineering, and tuning, develop an experiment based and evaluation workflow, package for production

Job requirements

• A strong educational background where coursework required heavy use of data and a scientific or engineering based workflows

• Experience with data processing, preparation, cleansing, and mining, in SQL and Python

• Experience developing dashboards and reports in a BI toolset

• Experience with applying data science and machine learning methods and move across a variety of unsupervised and supervised approaches, experience with NumPy, pandas, sci-kit learn

Working in a fast-paced, team-based environment also demands a certain degree of self-planning, as well as the ability to work independently. Your colleagues are highly skilled, innovative, and proactive in their work approach. They possess strong analytical skills, are good communicators in English, and take pride in their job and deliverables.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, People Operations & Employee Experience
jobs.description:
Job description

At Trackman, we use technology, data and innovation to transform the way sports are played, practiced and experienced around the world.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and develop our People Operations function as we continue to grow globally. With more than 1,100 employees worldwide this is an opportunity to strengthen and scale the processes, governance, technology and employee experience that support our organisation. Working closely with the Head of HR and key stakeholders, you will play an important role in shaping a modern, efficient, and globally connected function.

Why this role is different

Trackman has grown into a global organisation through innovation, strong products and talented people. As we continue to scale, we are investing in the infrastructure, systems and ways of working needed to support our next phase of growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building as much as operating. You will lead People Operations, drive improvements across the employee lifecycle, and help shape how technology, automation and strong governance enable a better employee experience.

You'll join at a pivotal stage in our journey, with the opportunity to make a visible and lasting impact across our global organisation.

What you will be responsible for

Lead and Develop People Operations

• 
Lead, coach and develop the HR Operations Specialist and HR Coordinator

• 
Build a high-performing, service-oriented People Operations team with clear responsibilities and standards

• 
Ensure operational excellence across all employee lifecycle

• 
Create scalable ways of working that support future growth

Own and improve the Global Employee Lifecycle

• 
Design, manage and continuously improve processes covering onboarding, internal mobility, employment changes, promotions, leave management, international relocations and offboarding

• 
Standardized processes across regions while accommodating local requirements

• 
Ensure efficient, consistent, and high-quality experience for employees and managers

Build Global Policies, Governance and Compliance

• 
Own and develop our global HR policy framework, standards and governance

• 
Develop global standards while enabling local compliance where required

• 
Partner with Finance and business leaders to establish clear approval of workflows, responsibilities and decision rights

Lead People Technology and Automation

A key priority will be developing a more technology-enabled People Operations function, using digitalization, automation, and AI to improve efficiency and employee experience. You will:

• 
Help shape our future People technology landscape and drive implementation of new solutions

• 
Identify opportunities for automation and self-service

• 
Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency and employee experience

• 
Improve data quality, reporting and operational insights

• 
Reduce manual administration through smarter ways of working

We’re looking for someone who is energized by technology and excited about the opportunity to simplify, automate, and improve ways of working.

Drive Employee Experience and operational insights

• 
Design user-friendly employee journeys and improve manager support and enablement

• 
Simplify processes and create a consistent people experience across regions and locations

• 
Measure and improve employee satisfaction with our People Operations services

• 
Partner with the People Data & Analytics function to ensure high-quality employee data, reliable reporting and insights that support informed decision-making

Job requirements

What you bring

We imagine that you bring:

• 
8+ years of HR experience with Significant experience within People Operations, Shared Services or Employee Experience

• 
Experience leading and developing teams in an international organisation

• 
A strong track record of improving global HR processes, governance and service delivery models

• 
Strong understanding of HR systems, digitalization and automation

• 
Experience working across multiple jurisdictions and employment frameworks

• 
Strong project, stakeholder and change management skills

• 
Excellent analytical and structured approach, with excellent problem-solving and organisational skills

What success could look like after 12-18 months

• 
A clear and scalable global People Operations model is established

• 
Core employee lifecycle processes are standardized and continuously improved

• 
Governance, policies and operational decision-making are clearer across the organisation

• 
Key People Technology initiatives have been defined and launched

• 
Manual processes have been reduced through automation and improved ways of working

• 
Employees and managers have a more consistent and efficient People experience globally

The Office

Join Siemens Energy as a Technical Project Manager and lead the technical execution of a large-scale high-voltage substation project: a 400 kV AC substation with GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear), Control & Protection systems, SCADA, telecommunications and auxiliary systems, which will connect future offshore wind. As the technical authority in the project organization, you report to the overall project manager and coordinate all technical disciplines on the Danish part of this flagship infrastructure project in Denmark, which runs until 2034. From design through installation and commissioning, you represent the technical side in meetings with the customer and a large international project organization, making a significant impact on the future of power transmission and the energy transition.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Leading the technical execution of a complex high-voltage substation project from design through installation and commissioning

• Coordinating a multidisciplinary team of 7-10 discipline leads, scope managers and engineering specialists, and ensuring each discipline delivers its commitments on time and to the required quality

• Driving technical planning and engineering schedules with a clear work breakdown, critical path and intermediate milestones, aligning interfaces and dependencies between work packages and monitoring progress against schedules and budgets

• Acting as the primary escalation point for technical challenges, managing technical risks and mitigation plans, and presenting technical solutions to the customer side by side with the overall project manager

• Participating in customer meetings and technical workshops, and collaborating closely with project management, site management, procurement, construction and commissioning teams

• Ensuring compliance with standards, regulations, employer requirements and contractual technical obligations, leading requirement management and traceability, and supporting design reviews

What You Bring

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline

• Minimum 5 years of experience leading technical teams and coordinating engineering disciplines within power transmission, substations or large infrastructure projects, for example as a technical project manager or senior technical lead

• Strong understanding of high-voltage substations, especially GIS and Control and Protection systems, as well as AIS, SCADA, communication and auxiliary systems

• Strong knowledge of engineering standards, specifications and requirement management, and experience working directly with customers, contractors and external stakeholders

• A structured, proactive and results-oriented leader who is confident in large customer-facing meetings and technical negotiations, and builds strong relationships across disciplines and organizations

• Fluent English, Danish is considered an advantage

About the Team

This position is part of our Substation engineering department in Denmark, which consists of four engineering teams and a number of specialists reporting directly to the Head of Engineering. In the project, the Technical Project Manager is supported by work package managers and experts within each technical discipline.

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Clipper is enhancing its internal tax capability as part of a continued focus on strengthening governance and decision support across the organisation. We are therefore looking for a dedicated and hands-on Tax Manager to be based at Clipper’s headquarters in Copenhagen.

Today, tax matters at Clipper are handled across Finance, Legal and external advisors. With increasing regulatory complexity and risk exposure, we are establishing a more formalized and proactive tax function. The Tax Manager will play a key role in building this capability and embedding robust tax governance across the organization.

You will report directly to the CFO and work closely with the Head of Legal & Corporate Affairs and Head of Controlling and external advisors.

What will be your responsibilities

You will be responsible for both strategic and operational tax matters across Clipper’s global activities. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Establish and maintain Clipper’s tax governance framework, including a tax risk register and clear processes for identifying, assessing and managing tax risks.

• Review the tax implications of material transactions and challenge tax positions and advice from external advisors where relevant.

• Own and oversee transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, benchmarking and documentation.

• Monitor and manage cross-border tax matters, including withholding tax, freight tax and permanent establishment risks.

• Oversee compliance with Danish tonnage tax requirements, including calculations, documentation and relevant controls.

• Coordinate corporate tax, VAT and employment tax compliance and reporting across jurisdictions, ensuring timely filings and robust documentation.

• Advise on tax matters related to international employee mobility and contractor arrangements.

• Monitor relevant tax and regulatory developments, including OECD Pillar Two and environmental and emissions-related taxes, and assess their impact on Clipper.

• Act as Clipper’s internal tax expert and trusted sparring partner, advising management on tax implications of strategic and operational decisions.

What we are looking for

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

• We imagine that you have a relevant educational background within finance, tax, business administration, law or similar, combined with solid experience in corporate and international tax.

• You have hands-on experience with tax governance and tax risk management, combined with strong knowledge of transfer pricing, cross-border taxation and international tax principles.

• You are comfortable working with external advisors while also challenging and validating tax positions when needed.

• You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic and commercially minded.

• You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and turning complex tax matters into practical advice and solutions for the business.

• You communicate confidently across functions and levels of the organisation and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Shipping experience, including knowledge of tonnage tax or other shipping-specific tax matters, is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A key role with significant influence on Clipper Bulk's tax framework and risk profile

• The opportunity to build and shape an internal tax function

• Close collaboration with senior management and exposure to strategic decision-making

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site paring, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Application and recruitment process

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our application portal by 22nd November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be treated with full discretion.

The recruitment process consist of two interview rounds. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview, while candidates progressing to the second round will be asked to complete a personality assessment beforehand. Confidential reference checks will be conducted for final candidates.

Learn more about Clipper at clipper-bulk.com, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Clipper is an industry leader in dry bulk, an operator, a pool manager, and a specialist in steel services. We operate a modern fleet of approximately 120 handysize and supramax vessels, transporting a wide range of cargo from dry bulk to break bulk. Clipper is commercially headquartered in Copenhagen and employs a staff of around 100 onshore worldwide. Candidate profile (text) - Default language Are you fascinated by the beauty of logistics? Would you like to work in an environment where things are done professionally? Can we rely on you even in the early hours of the day? If so, you are a good match as a logistic co-worker for our store.

Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us

Key responsibilities (text) In IKEA Logistics, we are responsible not just for receiving goods each day, but unloading the trucks, replenishing them in the store using forklifts, powered stackers and pallet lifters, ensuring that IKEA is ready by 10AM sharp when the store opens. As a logistics co-worker in our self-service warehouse, you play an important role in IKEA's sales figures and customers, as the department makes sure that customers never go in vain when it comes to buying furniture for their home. Everyday life is always busy, as we work with a sharp deadline.

In addition, we expect that you:

• Are in good physical shape and can handle manual labor

• Thrive by working during the early hours of the day

• Can prioritize and organize your own and the teams work to make efficient use of time

• Are able to communicate in English and enthusiastic about working in a team

• Have a Danish forklift license - or willing to acquire one.

Your tasks will be:

• Loading goods into the warehouse by driving reach truck and powered stacker

• Working together and following up with colleagues to keep the store fully stocked

• Goods receiving and handling, as well as updating IT systems accordingly

• Proactively securing the safety of your colleagues and our customers in your working area

• Goods replenishment for our customers

• Clean up and maintaining the department and machines.

Team vision ( title) Our team within IKEA

Team vision (text) You can become part of an international team of both fulltime and part-time employees that work towards a common goal. We secure an efficient replenishment of the store and provide good customer service, even though we do not have direct customer contact. We work closely together with all departments, and consequently gain experience in collaborating with many different types of people. We work in a fast-paced environment, but always support each other and work as a team. Therefore, there is room for you to be exactly who you are. We will ensure all necessary and correct trainings, so you will feel safe and competent in the job. At IKEA you have endless possibilities to grow!

Let's connect Questions and support? Let's connect!

Let´s connect If you have any questions please contact our Logistics Team Leader, Artúr Hajdu (artur.hajdu@inkga.ikea.com) Please note that we only accept applications via our recruitment system and not by email.

Local section (title) Further information

Local section (text) • This position is for an average of 20 hours per week

• Working hours between 04:00 to 12:00. You should expect to work every third weekend. It is possible to give your input for the work schedule

• Salary is within IKEAs banding for logistics and includes pension- and free choice allowance and odd hour payment

• Other employment terms follow HKs Funktionæroverenskomst

• We have various staff benefits including private health insurance, massage, Cantine, staff discount, discount club with external partners, yearly gift, bonus etc.

• During the recruitment process, we reserve the right to ask for a criminal record

• Start date is as early as possible

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates.

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience. We hope you will join us on this adventure, and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

Why you will love us

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

What we all have in common

• Living our values

• Being your unique self, while respecting and including others

• A passion for home furnishing

• Performing & delivering while learning & developing

• Having fun!

jobs.occupation: PhD Stipend in Experimental Quantum Materials Physics
jobs.description:
Join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production at Aalborg University and contribute to research on the quantum properties of matter at the scale of individual atoms and molecules. This is a full-time, fixed-term PhD stipend for three years, commencing on 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter

**Your work tasks

**The Department of Materials and Production is looking for a PhD candidate in experimental physics to investigate how molecular complexes can be used to engineer quantum properties in materials. The project addresses fundamental questions in quantum science while contributing knowledge that may support future applications within electronics, sensing and energy harvesting. You will become part of the Physics Group and work in an international research collaboration funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark.

Your research will focus on preparing and investigating molecular complexes on crystalline surfaces. You will deposit molecular complexes by electrospray techniques under ultra-high-vacuum conditions and study their structural and electronic properties using low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. The work will involve planning and conducting experiments, documenting methods and results, analysing and discussing data, and communicating findings clearly within the research collaboration and through relevant scientific channels. You will carry out a substantial part of the research independently while collaborating closely with researchers in the project.

Your competencies You hold a master's degree in physics, nanoscience or a closely related field. You have a solid experimental background within physics, surface science or nanoscience, together with documented experience in scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, ultra-high-vacuum techniques, cryogenic systems, surface science and electrospray deposition.

You can organise and conduct experimental research in a systematic manner, from the planning of measurements to the documentation, analysis and interpretation of results. You communicate methods and findings clearly in English, both in writing and in dialogue with other researchers. The position calls for a researcher who can take responsibility for their own work while contributing constructively to a collaborative and international research environment.

**Qualification requirements

**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are

You will join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production, where research activities explore materials and physical phenomena relevant to both fundamental science and future technologies. In this position, you will work at the intersection of molecular science, surface science and quantum materials research, with access to a research environment in which experimental methods and scientific discussion form the basis for developing new knowledge.

As part of an international collaboration, you will have the opportunity to engage with researchers across disciplines and contribute to a research project with both scientific depth and technological relevance. The position offers a strong foundation for further work in academic research, advanced experimental physics or research-intensive development environments.

**How to apply

**Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)

• Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment

**The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
